entries.title: Book IV: The Nerves
entries.content:
"Τὰ νεῦρα ὁδοὶ τῶν τοῦ σώματος σημάτων."
(The nerves are the pathways through which the body's signals travel.)

entries.title: Book IV: The Nerves
entries.content: The body becomes a network. Nerves form unseen pathways linking movement, sensation, and coordination.

entries.title: Book IV: The Nerves
entries.content: The body is not only moved—it is directed. Signals pass, connect, and organise. The brain begins to emerge as a centre of control.
